_meta.mechanism: Per-category embedding = uniform mean of K=4 normalized paraphrase embeddings, renormalized. PTE REPLACES the committed learned-weight 6-prompt ensemble for a category column (prompt_weights.json is cleanly bypassed: len-4 PTE never matches the len-6 learned weights, so anomaly_expert._precompute_text_features falls back to uniform mean; the precheck applies uniform mean explicitly). Normal column and all non-target category columns stay at the committed representation.
_meta.template_family: same surveillance-style family as anomaly_expert.CATEGORY_PROMPTS ('a surveillance video of ...', 'security camera footage of ...', 'CCTV footage of ...', 'a surveillance scene ...') with deliberate register/length diversity

Abuse: a surveillance video of physical abuse, a person hitting or hurting a defenseless victim
security camera footage of someone being beaten or kicked while unable to fight back
CCTV footage of a stronger person repeatedly striking a helpless victim
a surveillance scene of domestic violence, one person attacking another who is cowering
Arrest: a surveillance video of police officers arresting and handcuffing a suspect
security camera footage of law enforcement restraining a person on the ground
CCTV footage of uniformed officers surrounding and subduing a suspect
a surveillance scene with a patrol car and a person being taken into custody
Arson: a surveillance video of arson, a person deliberately setting fire to a building
security camera footage of someone igniting a fire with a lighter or flammable liquid
CCTV footage of a fire starting small at one point and spreading across the scene
a surveillance scene of deliberate fire-setting with a person near the flames' origin
Assault: a surveillance video of a one-sided assault, an attacker beating a passive victim
security camera footage of a violent attack where the victim is cowering or falling
CCTV footage of an assailant punching and kicking someone who is not fighting back
a surveillance scene of a person knocked to the ground by an aggressor
Burglary: a surveillance video of burglary, a person forcing open a door or window to enter
security camera footage of someone climbing through a window into a closed building
CCTV footage of a person breaking a lock or prying a door to gain entry
a surveillance scene of forced entry, someone sneaking into a building at night
Explosion: a surveillance video of an explosion, a sudden bright flash and massive dust cloud
security camera footage of a violent blast with debris flying through the air
CCTV footage of a detonation turning a calm scene into chaos in one instant
a surveillance scene of a huge fireball and shockwave engulfing the frame in smoke
Fighting: a surveillance video of two people fighting, both throwing punches at each other
security camera footage of a brawl where all participants are actively hitting each other
CCTV footage of two people grappling and wrestling aggressively
a surveillance scene of mutual combat, both sides exchanging blows
RoadAccidents: a photo of a road accident, vehicle collision
a car crash on the street
vehicles collided with debris on the road
Robbery: a surveillance video of armed robbery, a person pointing a gun or knife at a victim

CCTV footage of a robber with a visible weapon taking money or belongings by force
a surveillance scene of an armed person demanding valuables from a store clerk
Shooting: a surveillance video of a shooting, a person firing a gun with visible muzzle flash
security camera footage of gunfire, people falling to the ground or fleeing in panic
CCTV footage of a crowd scattering and running in all directions from gunshots
a surveillance scene where people suddenly collapse or duck in terror from gunfire
Shoplifting: a surveillance video inside a retail store of a person concealing merchandise under clothing

CCTV footage of a shopper stuffing items into a pocket and walking toward the exit
a store surveillance scene of a person secretly taking items off shelves without paying

security camera footage of someone picking up an unattended purse or laptop and leaving
CCTV footage of a person snatching an item from someone's hand and fleeing

Vandalism: a surveillance video of vandalism, a person smashing a car window or storefront
security camera footage of someone spray-painting graffiti on a wall
CCTV footage of a person kicking and destroying street furniture or public property
a surveillance scene of deliberate property destruction, throwing rocks at windows or vehicles
